author: Forbes
description:
At the Forbes 30/50 Summit, Forbes Under 30 Associate Editor Alex York sits down with two powerhouse athlete-entrepreneurs: Olympic medalist gymnast Jordan Chiles and WNBA star and rapper Flau’jae Johnson.

In this high-energy conversation, Jordan and Flau’jae dive into how the NIL era transformed women's sports into viable long-term careers. They share insights on managing multifaceted careers—from music studios to Olympic mats—handling business equity, and applying an athlete's execution mindset to entrepreneurship.

author: Forbes
description:
Symone Sanders Townsend, co-host, MSNBC's "The Weekend," sits down with Her Excellency Amna Al-Muhajiri, Consul General of the UAE in New York, and Alya Al-Suwaidi, Deputy Chief of Mission at the UAE Embassy in Washington, D.C., for an insightful panel on global leadership, diplomacy, and mentorship.

In this dynamic discussion, these distinguished diplomats share their personal journeys into the foreign service, how they established authority in high-stakes diplomatic rooms, and the art of building long-term trust across changing U.S. political administrations. They also share valuable advice for empowering young women and future generations of leaders.
